query_text: Where can I buy the latest iPhone?

parts.text:
As of **June 2026**, the latest iPhone lineup is the **iPhone 17 series** (comprising the standard **iPhone 17**, the ultra-slim **iPhone 17 Air**, the **iPhone 17 Pro**, and the **iPhone 17 Pro Max**), alongside the more budget-friendly **iPhone 17e**.

Depending on your preference for buying it outright, financing it, or upgrading through a mobile carrier, you can buy the latest iPhone from several authorized channels:

### 1. Directly from Apple (Online & In-Store)
Buying directly from Apple is the most straightforward way to get an unlocked phone that can be used on any network.
* **Apple Store Online / Apple Store App:** You can order directly from Apple's website or app and opt for home delivery or same-day pickup at a local Apple Store.
* **Physical Apple Retail Stores:** You can visit a brick-and-mortar Apple Store to test out the different models (like comparing the lightweight iPhone 17 Air to the premium iPhone 17 Pro) and get assistance from their staff.
* **Benefits:** Access to Apple’s official trade-in program, easy configuration of AppleCare+ protection, and customization of financing options (like the Apple Card Monthly Installments in the US).

### 2. Major Mobile Carriers
If you plan to tie your new phone to a cellular service contract or upgrade your current line, mobile carriers often offer some of the most aggressive promotional deals (such as "free" phones via bill credits with a qualifying trade-in and unlimited plan).
* **In the US:** Verizon, T-Mobile, and AT&T.
* **In the UK:** EE, Vodafone, O2, and Three.
* **In Canada & Europe:** Rogers, Telus, Bell, Orange, Deutsche Telekom, etc.
* **Benefits:** Heavy discounts on the device if you commit to a 24- or 36-month service contract, and the ability to bundle your phone payment with your monthly phone bill.

### 3. Major Authorized Retailers
Large electronic and department store chains carry the latest iPhones both in-store and online. They frequently run their own store-wide promotions or offer exclusive gift cards with purchase.
* **Best Buy:** Excellent for finding both carrier-linked and unlocked models, and they regularly match or beat carrier trade-in promotions.
* **Target & Walmart:** Often carry carrier-locked models and occasionally offer store gift cards as a purchasing incentive.
* **Amazon:** Usually sells unlocked versions of the latest iPhones, though make sure you are purchasing directly from the official **Apple Store on Amazon** to ensure you receive a genuine, brand-new device.
* **International Retailers:** If you are outside the US, major chains like **Currys** (UK), **MediaMarkt / Saturn** (Europe), **Fnac** (France/Spain), and **JB Hi-Fi** (Australia) are officially authorized to sell the latest models.

### Quick Buying Tips:
* **Check for Trade-Ins:** No matter where you buy, the latest iPhones can be expensive. Trading in your current smartphone (especially an iPhone 15 or 16) is the best way to significantly lower the upfront cost.
* **Know the Difference Between Unlocked vs. Carrier-Locked:** If you travel frequently or plan to switch carriers soon, buy an **unlocked** device directly from Apple or an authorized retail store. If you buy a carrier-discounted phone, it will typically be locked to that carrier until it is paid off in full.
